title: Scout (telemetry gap): what per-task outcome data exists vs what a per-model scorecard needs
spec: Read-only. Goal: route work between executor models from live outcomes. Inventory, with path:line: (1) every field written by bus.log_run (orchestrator/spawn.py, orchestrator/executor.py) into .orchestrator/runs/<date>.jsonl; (2) per-task fields on the bus json that record outcome: status, rounds, reason, resume_hint, result.summary, review verdict/comments, merged_into, sha, fallback, tier, account (orchestrator/bus.py, executor.py, merge.py, spawn.py); (3) how `orchestrator cost --by tier` aggregates (cli.py). Then list the gaps for a scorecard keyed by executor model: task success (merged vs failed), rounds to green, wall time, tokens/USD, cooldown/usage-limit hits, review request_changes count, complexity bucket. Propose the minimal additional fields (name, where written) and a scorecard.json shape under .orchestrator/. Note which of these need a merge-time write (merge.py) vs a run-time write. Max 15 findings.
acceptance: complete list of log_run call sites with fields, path:line
gap list maps each scorecard metric to existing field or 'missing: write at <path>'
